_comment: POINT LAYERS the map clusters on its own (2026-10-05, physical acceptance: webcams were an anonymous density and tiny marks). One entry per type: the property whose values the map tells apart, the colour of the layer, and per value a mark (shape and a word, never colour alone) and its name in the legend and tooltips. A value not listed is drawn as 'other'. 'external_live' is the official live channels of public bodies (YouTube, src/config/ops.json), shown with the webcams.
